command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.MainActivity --ez run_shizuku_probe true >/dev/null; sleep 3; echo '=== AiCallBridge log ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S' || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/aicall-auth-window.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo '=== visible UI text ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/aicall-auth-window.xml 2>/dev/null | sed 's/></>\n</g' | grep -o 'text="[^"]*"' | head -n 120 || true; echo phase2d_shizuku_app_auth_check_complete=true
